posts.name: Switch
posts.tagline: Bring any AI agent into Slack, Teams & Discord
posts.description: Switch brings AI agents into the collaboration tools your team already uses. Agents join as named participants in your Slack, Teams, Discord, or Telegram channels, sharing the same context and history as your team. Connect an agent once and use it across projects. Each room carries its own context, participants, and rules. Works with Claude Code, OpenAI, Google ADK, LangChain, and more. Open source, self-hostable, running in minutes.

posts.name: Widgo
posts.tagline: AI Sales rep for your website visitors
posts.description: Widgo is an AI sales rep on your website. It scans your site, adds any docs you give it, and answers every visitor from that alone. It identifies the company, scores the lead, and books the demo on your calendar. One line of code. Free forever, no card.

posts.name: Kombai Gallery
posts.tagline: 20,000+ curated UI designs for agents and humans
posts.description: Build standout UIs by giving your agent design taste. Browse curated web and mobile designs, from full pages to individual components. Preview them live and copy a ready-to-use prompt. The gallery is free forever, with no sign-up required.

posts.name: OpenMarket
posts.tagline: Multi-agent marketplace where proof decides who wins
posts.description: What if marketplaces rewarded the best product instead of the best marketing? OpenMarket (in research preview), is a multi-agent marketplace where sellers pitch, competitors challenge their claims, and independent truth agents verify the evidence as they compete to earn a buyer's sale. Here, claims don’t count just because they’re written on a product page. They have to survive scrutiny and be proven.

posts.name: Knockin'
posts.tagline: Turns your static bio into an AI business card that replies
posts.description: Knockin turns your bio into an AI business card people can chat with. Add your work, links, and content. It learns what you do and answers questions in your voice. Visitors can book time with you right away, even when you’re away. Knockin remembers who stopped by, so you know who to follow up with. This cuts down on back and forth and gives both sides more context before a call.

posts.name: GoodLads
posts.tagline: AI growth manager for your Google Ads account
posts.description: AI growth manager for Google Ads accounts. GoodLads generates hypotheses to improve your ROAS or CPA, ships each one in one click - never without your approval - and tracks it on a kanban board to a verdict.

posts.name: Relaticle
posts.tagline: Open-source CRM with approval-gated AI writes
posts.description: Most CRMs bolt AI on. Relaticle is built agent-first: any MCP client gets 37 first-party tools over OAuth, with workspace custom fields in each agent's schema automatically. The in-app assistant is stricter: every write is a proposal showing the exact change, approved record by record. Self-host everything under AGPL, including local inference with Ollama. Free forever self-hosted; Cloud is flat per-workspace pricing, not per-seat.

posts.name: Dictantor
posts.tagline: Record meetings and transcribe privately on Apple devices
posts.description: Dictantor captures meetings and voice notes across Mac, iPhone, and Apple Watch. On Mac, it records microphone and system audio together and prompts you before meetings. Transcription runs on device in 25 European languages, separating your voice from everyone else. Search returns you to exact spoken moments. No Dictantor account or subscription. Supported recordings can sync through your private iCloud account.

posts.name: Jupitrr Cut
posts.tagline: Open source app for recording vids with a teleprompter
posts.description: Jupitrr Cut is an open-source mobile app for recording polished talking-head videos. Use the built-in teleprompter to read line by line, retake anything, and automatically remove silences. Export a finished video without touching a timeline. Record the video. Skip the edit. Add captions and B-roll later with Jupitrr AI—completely optional. No account wall. GPL-3.0 licensed, with the APK on GitHub and one-tap updates through the App Store and Google Play.

posts.name: Replay QA Security Scan
posts.tagline: Automated Penetration Testing  for AI-Built Apps
posts.description: Replay pentests your web app on every QA pass now: injection flaws, broken access control, IDOR, the stuff AI-generated code tends to miss. Findings come back as full bug reports, evidence and suggested fix included. Schedule it daily or weekly and skip the "remember to test" step. You wake up to a queue of bugs already triaged. Same projects also test against dev, staging, prod, and localhost, so you're not maintaining separate QA setups per environment.

posts.name: SODAX SDK
posts.tagline: Digital asset flows you can build and deploy with AI.
posts.description: SODAX provides a highly customizable execution system to build stablecoin, crypto and real world asset transactions. Focus on your product and user experience without the technical debt of managing the interface with blockchain technology. Neobanks, exchanges, lending and yield protocols integrate the SODAX SDK to ship our full range of features, across transaction, lending and yield, faster and extend their operational reach across blockchain networks. SODAX is infrastructure for modern money.

posts.name: Tables.so
posts.tagline: AI that finds, qualifies and enriches your next customer
posts.description: Finding new customers takes way too long and most of that time goes into work nobody wants to do. So we built Tables. You write who you are looking for in normal language and Tables goes through 300M+ verified contacts, looks into each one and answers the questions you actually care about. You get a scored list with emails, phone numbers and the sources behind every answer, so you can check it. Syncs with HubSpot, Pipedrive and Attio, and works on LinkedIn and inside Claude.

posts.name: Nametag
posts.tagline: Your social memory to never forget a name and person again
posts.description: People love you when you remember their name. Nametag AI is a simple app that helps you remember names of people you meet. By using location, Nametag remembers where you met a person so that the next time you visit you can review your flashcard cram deck before walking in. To save someone, simply tap and speak. "Jake, tall, mustache glasses, loves cooking, knows Jane." Nametag AI takes the voice capture and categorizes the information automatically into descriptors, mutuals, & fun facts.

posts.name: Kopai
posts.tagline: The Cloud for AI Agents
posts.description: Kopai is the cloud for AI agents. Build the agent; we run it. Publish any agent as an API (native or OpenAI-compatible, with streaming), list it in the marketplace, or call it from your own product. Analytics count what an agent costs to run separately from what it earns. A one-command benchmark runs it against reference agents before you ship. Certification expires, and answers get re-checked. Chat and the API use the same engine, so an exported agent behaves like the one you tested.

posts.name: AppGacha
posts.tagline: Turn a sentence into a tiny desktop app
posts.description: AppGacha turns a plain-language wish into a real desktop app—utilities, widgets, games, and personal tools. Apps run locally, stay portable, and can be organized into your own desktop workspace.

posts.name: Coherence X6 for macOS
posts.tagline: Turn websites into Mac apps powered by your browser
posts.description: Coherence X6 turns websites into isolated, customizable Mac apps powered by Chrome and other Chromium browsers. Bring your profiles, logins, bookmarks, and extensions, then control how each app looks, opens, and routes links.

posts.name: Catenary
posts.tagline: Spatial canvas IDE for AI coding agents
posts.description: Catenary is a spatial IDE and terminal orchestrator that reimagines coding with AI agents. Instead of drowning in terminal tabs: • Visual Cables: Wire agents to pass context & run multi-model squads • New Task Islands: Spin up isolated visual workspaces in 1 click • All-in-One: Monaco editor, native PTY terminals & browser previews • 100% Local-First: Zero telemetry, fully offline & private Free for macOS, Windows & Linux: thecatenary.app

posts.name: Lyrimuse
posts.tagline: Word-synced macOS lyrics that pick the right version
posts.description: Word-synced desktop lyrics for Apple Music, Spotify, QQ Music, NetEase, Kugou, and for YouTube Music or Spotify Web in a browser. Nine lyric providers are queried at once and every candidate is scored on one scale — title, artist, album, duration fit, word-level timing — so live takes, Cantonese versions and radio edits get the words that actually match. Shows up as a floating overlay, a Dynamic Island capsule, an Apple-Music-style window, or in the menu bar. Free and open source, no account.

posts.name: bonds
posts.tagline: AI messenger that builds shared apps inside your group chats
posts.description: Just talk, and the apps your group or friends needs appear in the chat. "We're 4 friends training for a marathon, build us a tracker" becomes a real app: leaderboard, streaks, a $500 pot, and the AI poking whoever skips a run. Shared software, generated on the fly: native iOS UI, one live state for the whole chat, zero setup. Full-blown social apps, not widgets. We're starting with fitness. A real messenger. Free.

posts.name: Pastea
posts.tagline: Save + search through links, snippets + screenshots you copy
posts.description: Pastea is a clipboard history manager for macOS. It saves every link, snippet and screenshot you copy, so you can search, pin and paste it back in seconds.

posts.name: TapCraft
posts.tagline: App Demo Studio for mobile apps
posts.description: Most device-video tools are Mac-only and built for landscape desktop demos. App Store previews are 9:16. TapCraft runs in the browser. Drop in an Android or iOS screen recording, wrap it in a real Pixel / iPhone / Galaxy frame, add tap ripples (click to place, or import exact coordinates from adb), auto-zoom the camera, cover the recorder's red chip, and export 1080 or 2K. Free is unlimited and watermarked.

posts.name: Trancy Air
posts.tagline: Translate anything you see, write, or say with one hotkey
posts.description: Trancy Air is a shortcut-driven translator that sits ready on macOS and Windows. In any app: select what you can't read and it's translated; write in your own language and one key swaps it to another; too lazy to type, just talk. It also catches mistakes, polishes wording, reads text aloud and scores your pronunciation.

posts.name: artha.link
posts.tagline: Share jobs and earn per click, apply or hire
posts.description: artha.link gives creators relevant jobs to share with their audience and rewards them for every click, application, and hire they generate. In just eight months, we've paid $100K+ to creators, with 8.2M+ jobs on the platform, 30K+ candidates visiting jobs every day, and 150K+ applications generated. It’s creator-led hiring.

posts.name: ReplyHey
posts.tagline: Automate your Reddit, X and LinkedIn Marketing
posts.description: Stop missing out on customers asking for help. ReplyHey finds posts on Reddit, X, and LinkedIn where people need what you offer, then drafts replies for you—no more endless scrolling or cold DMs. Prioritize the best leads with scoring and reply in one click. Built for founders and marketers who want real engagement, not just another list of contacts.

posts.name: MiniCPM5-2B
posts.tagline: Small enough for the device, built to act
posts.description: MiniCPM5-2B is OpenBMB's dense 2B follow-up to MiniCPM5-1B. It is built for on-device and local use, leads the 2B open-source class, and stays competitive with larger 4B models on coding, math, long context, and agent tasks. Apache 2.0 weights, GGUF, and MLX are up.

posts.name: Kody
posts.tagline: The home your agents share. Switch agents. Keep your stuff.
posts.description: Keep using the agent you already have. Kody is the account your tools, memory, secrets, and automations live on when you switch. Ask once. Save the working answer as owned package code. Invoke it from Cursor, Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, Grok, or any MCP host and optionally schedule it so it runs with no model in the loop. Not another chat app. Not another agent. The home your agents share.

posts.name: US Global Mail - MCP Server
posts.tagline: Connect your physical mail directly to AI
posts.description: The US Global Mail MCP Server connects your physical mail to AI, giving AI assistants secure access to find and manage your mail and take action for you. Ask your AI to find important mail, scan an envelope, ship mail, deposit a check, or create automated mail rules. Manage your physical mail directly from your favorite AI assistant. Physical Mail → AI → Action.

posts.name: Cheso
posts.tagline: AI presentations that think deeper
posts.description: Most AI decks stop at the surface. Cheso goes deeper. Turn your files, links, and notes into a clear story — researched, structured, and ready as editable slides, interactive pages, and more.

posts.name: Datawyse
posts.tagline: AI Finance Analyst for Small & Medium Enterprises
posts.description: Scenario plans, variance analysis, cash forecasts, delivered in minutes, verifiable line by line, at a third the cost of an analyst hire. Connects to your ERP, CRM, and business tools.Learns the rules, patterns, and definitions your business actually runs on. Then puts specialist finance agents to work on top. The LLM plans the analysis but never produces a number. Calculations run as code, and every figure comes back with its formula and source in Excel terms.

posts.name: Fiuto
posts.tagline: Find out what your users will say.
posts.description: Fiuto is all you need for user research: it writes the study, runs it with AI testers and real people, and turns what happened into findings and a deck you can share. Free to start, in minutes, no experience required. In the browser or over MCP.

posts.name: Fleck AI
posts.tagline: One Connected Product Design Flow. AI-Powered, Human-Guided.
posts.description: Fleck AI bridges the gap between fast AI generation and real product thinking. Validate ideas, define what to build, map user flows, design multi-screen experiences, audit UX, and prepare production-ready handoffs, all in one connected flow. Then create case studies, publish to your portfolio, get discovered, and keep improving with Fleck Mentor.

posts.name: Corvic AI
posts.tagline: The enterprise knowledge backend for your agents
posts.description: Your agents are only as smart as the context you give them. Corvic AI turns your messy, scattered data: Slack threads, PDFs, docs, databases into a living knowledge backend: relational knowledge graphs with Memory, structured extraction with Lens, and grounded context served straight to your LLMs through MCP. Less hallucination, more real answers. Then build dashboards and custom apps on top, with no separate database and no extra infra to manage.

posts.name: Ajelix Enterprise
posts.tagline: Agentic AI multi-tenant platform for enterprise operations
posts.description: Ajelix Enterprise is a multi-tenant AI platform to run, control, and deploy AI in organizations. Agents handle complex multi-step tasks autonomously, no-code workflows connect tools and teams on a visual canvas, and a full governance layer delivers audit trails, guardrails, and spend controls on every interaction. Runs on Ajelix-owned high-computing infrastructure with frontier open-source models. Partner program available.

posts.name: WhyConvert
posts.tagline: Show quantity breaks. Sell more per order
posts.description: WhyConvert helps Shopify merchants increase order value with quantity breaks and tiered pricing. Show customers exactly how much they save as they buy more, then automatically apply the matching discount at checkout. No code, no discount codes, no complicated setup.

posts.name: Havadis AI
posts.tagline: Content that ranks on Google and gets cited by AI
posts.description: Give Havadis your website. It learns your brand, suggests what to write about, then writes it: blog articles, Instagram, LinkedIn, X threads, Pinterest and video concepts, with SEO, AEO and GEO applied in one run. Plan a month, schedule, publish. Built for small teams that need to show up on Google and in AI answers without hiring a content team. Free tier, no card.

posts.name: GifBook
posts.tagline: Turn any GIF into a printable, bound flipbook in minutes
posts.description: GifBook lets you transform any GIF into a tangible flipbook. Open a GIF in your browser, preview the animated mockup, and generate a free print‑at‑home PDF that you can cut and bind yourself. When you’re ready for the real thing, approve the proof and order professionally printed, bound flipbooks in packs of five with shipping included in the US and Canada. Customize covers, titles, and styles, and keep your file on your computer until you place an order for print

posts.name: Qaree: Memoriz Quran & Hifz
posts.tagline: A hifz companion that counts your repetitions
posts.description: An offline-first Qur'an memorization app. Repeat an ayah until it's yours, let progressive word hiding take over, and see which ayahs are slipping. No account, no ads.

posts.name: Transmit
posts.tagline: Free sandbox email API. Credits that roll over.
posts.description: Most email APIs make you verify a domain before you can really test. Your first “test” is already a send. Transmit starts in a free sandbox: separate keys, simulated email, real webhooks. Sandbox keys never send — like Stripe. No domain to start. When you’re ready: subscribe, verify domain, create a live key. Same API. Real delivery. $20/mo adds 30,000 emails. Unused credits roll over. No tiers. No midnight reset. Build first. Send when you’re ready. transmit.dev

posts.name: Sellora AI
posts.tagline: Chase Life, Not Leads.
posts.description: Sellora is a simple, fully autonomous virtual SDR built for real sales teams, not technical users. Unlike tools focused only on email automation or voice agents, Sellora researches prospects, finds contacts, writes personalized outreach, sends emails, makes calls, follows up, remembers conversations, handles replies and books meetings. No workflows, coding or AI prompting needed. Add your company and offer, and Sellora starts selling.

posts.name: Rotpitch
posts.tagline: Turn any video into a split-screen clip that people watch
posts.description: Making a split-screen clip normally means an editor, a timeline, and 40 minutes. RotPitch takes one upload and returns a finished 9:16 video: your footage stacked on a high-retention background loop, speech transcribed and captions burned in, ready to post. Auto Generate returns 2-5 variants on different backgrounds, so you test which hook lands instead of guessing. No watermark on paid plans, renders in ~12 seconds, one free credit that never expires.

posts.name: Subo 1.3
posts.tagline: Subscription tracking built around what’s next
posts.description: Subo 1.3 rebuilds the app around what happens next. A new Upcoming view brings your next renewal, a visual monthly calendar, attention-worthy events, and upcoming payments into one clear place. It’s designed to help you see what’s coming without digging through a list. Still private by design, with on-device data, optional iCloud sync, and no bank connection.

posts.name: VitaeMap
posts.tagline: You are more than a résumé ! Storytell your life and share.
posts.description: See the story behind your CV. Turn your LinkedIn profile, experiences, choices, failures, passions and turning points into a living visual map. Explore your journey through timelines, maps and playful representations, spot patterns, and discover what shaped you. Not another profile. Not another résumé. A new way to make your journey visible. Because your life is more than a list of jobs.

posts.name: Antwork
posts.tagline: Manage your social media from Claude or ChatGPT
posts.description: Every other scheduler is a dashboard you have to remember to open. Antwork is not. You connect your accounts once, then ask the AI you already use. Claude, ChatGPT, whatever is open. It drafts, schedules and publishes across eight platforms. Drafts come from your own recent posts, per account, so your brand page and your personal profile do not end up sounding the same. Pricing is per connected account. Two free, then $5 a month each. No plans, no tiers, no seats. I build it on my own.

posts.name: Goal Rings
posts.tagline: always-visible goal rings on the edge of your Mac's screen
posts.description: Turn revenue, visitors, words written — any metric — into always-visible goal rings on the edge of your Mac's screen. Daily, weekly and monthly goals with a pace tick that makes right now matter, and full-screen celebrations when a ring closes.

posts.name: StandBye
posts.tagline: A standing team of AI agents. Working while you're away.
posts.description: StandBye is a bring-your-own-keys Desktop app. Describe a team of AI agents and they keep working on your repo around the clock: they check in, talk in channels, ask you only when a decision is yours, and remember what they learn.

posts.name: PromptBucket
posts.tagline: Create AI images, videos, and agents in one place
posts.description: PromptBucket brings image and video generation, tool-connected AI agents, and a remixable creative community into one workspace. Create with leading models, connect apps, keep private work in your Vault, or publish reusable prompts and Agent Cards with attribution and remix lineage.

posts.name: Monitorion
posts.tagline: Uptime monitoring with 26 check types & free beta
posts.description: Uptime monitoring that checks 26 things, not just "is it up?" SSL & domain expiry, DNS, security headers, broken links, APIs, multi-step & browser flows — checked from multiple regions so blips don't false-alarm. 10 alert channels. Agencies: per-client projects, white-label status pages, SLA reports. We're running a free beta: testers get the full product (200 monitors) free in exchange for feedback — a "found a glitch?" button is built in. Follow, or start free at app.monitorion.com

posts.name: FreshForFeed
posts.tagline: Turn trending Reels & TikToks into scripts in your voice
posts.description: Reverse-engineer why viral short-form videos work and generate personalized scripts for your cFreshForFeed reverse-engineers viral TikToks, Reels, and Shorts into word-for-word retention scripts tailored to your creator voice DNA. Get visual cues, hook psychology breakdowns, and 30-day content plans in seconds.ontent. Powered by AI.

posts.name: Cue
posts.tagline: One key, in every app. Your words, already written.
posts.description: Cue is an AI assistant that lives in every window on your Mac and in a keyboard on your iPhone. Press one key wherever you are. Tap it to draft a reply in your voice from the thread you are reading. Hold it to dictate: your words land in the field cleaned up, dialect kept, in 17 languages. Double-tap to talk, and ask about what is on your screen. It records and writes up meetings, reads your connected accounts, and never sends anything for you. Free plan, no card. Fourteen days of Pro to start.

posts.name: FetchMark
posts.tagline: If Pocket shuts down, your bookmarks should not be lost.
posts.description: Pocket shut down. We built the replacement that doesn't lose your bookmarks. FetchMark saves any article in one click, auto-organizes with tags & folders, and makes everything fully searchable — even inside the articles. Full-text search, offline reading when installed as PWA, instant import from Pocket/Chrome. Your reading list is finally organized.

posts.name: AI Graph Studio
posts.tagline: Visual architecture for agentic AI systems
posts.description: AI Graph Studio is a free, open-source, vendor-neutral visual workbench for designing, documenting and analyzing agentic AI architectures. Build graphs with agents, LLMs, tools, routing, memory, RAG, loops, evaluators, guardrails, human approvals and parallel flows. Analyze architectural issues, estimate tokens and costs, simulate workflows, and export to JSON, SVG, PNG, Markdown or Mermaid. Runs locally in your browser with no account or API keys required.

posts.name: Really Simple Podcast Player
posts.tagline: Plays podcasts offline. No account, no ads, no tracking!
posts.description: Most podcast apps are a streaming catalogue behind a login. This one plays files from a folder you pick, so it works with the network off — plane, car, no signal. Built so a child who can't read can drive it. The shelf is cover art, not menus. Skipping an episode needs a hold, so a stray tap can't lose their place. A PIN guards the volume cap, the folder, and a sleep timer that can't be turned off without it — a bedtime, not a suggestion. No ads, no accounts, no tracking. OPML in and out.

posts.name: Super
posts.tagline: API-First, Rust-Powered Process Orchestration for the Edge.
posts.description: The API-First, Lightweight Process Orchestrator for the Edge. Super is a modern replacement for tools like Supervisor or PM2, built with Rust. It is designed for edge computing, IoT devices, and high-performance servers.

posts.name: Journal.IO
posts.tagline: Journal daily. See what you keep circling back to.
posts.description: A calm journaling app that turns what you write into patterns you can see. Ask Jade about your own history, watch themes build on the Mind Map based on neuroscience, and track habits!

posts.name: Closewatch
posts.tagline: Stop guessing whether the client read your proposal
posts.description: Every proposal tool reports opens. Most of that number is link scanners, and "was it opened" was never the real question. Closewatch scores each proposal and shows its work: "forwarded to someone else", "3m 51s on pricing", "came back on a later day". The dashboard is a call list, not a stats page. Scanners are filtered out and only visible reading time counts. One link per recipient, so a second reader means it reached the person who signs. It's the PDF you already send.

posts.name: Journey Jotter
posts.tagline: Travel journaling in 3 minutes, written in your own voice
posts.description: Most travellers want to document their trips, but actually sitting down to journal every day takes time. Miss a day or two and suddenly you're a week behind. Photos and travel apps are great at remembering where you went, but not what actually happened. Journey Jotter lets you talk or type about your day, answers with thoughtful prompts, then turns it into a beautiful journal written in your own voice — in under three minutes, giving you the time back to enjoy your travels.

posts.name: All2ools
posts.tagline: Free Online AI Tools for Every Task
posts.description: Hey Product Hunt! 👋 I’m the maker of All2ools. I got tired of hitting file size limits, paywalls, and constant registration prompts on massive PDF and utility sites. So, I built All2ools to be a completely friction-free workspace for creators, students, and professionals. It’s 100% free, requires no accounts, and doesn't clutter your screen with ads. I’d love to hear your feedback on how we can make our tool suite even better for you today!"

posts.name: LetX
posts.tagline: Write LaTeX together. The AI runs the build.
posts.description: Most AI tools hand you LaTeX and leave you to paste it somewhere and hope it builds. Lexi works inside the project: it creates and edits files, builds tables and TikZ diagrams, fixes your bibliography, compiles, reads the real latexmk log, and fixes what it reported. Every edit snapshots first, so it can be reverted. Connect Claude or ChatGPT over MCP and they get the same project: 1,019 templates, create, edit, compile. Unlimited collaborators on every plan. Overleaf's free tier allows one.

posts.name: PerfLocale
posts.tagline: Performance-first multilingual WordPress plugin
posts.description: Multilingual WordPress without the overhead. Posts, pages, products, taxonomies, strings and slugs - translated using WordPress core APIs alone, with zero third-party PHP libraries. GPL, free, no per-site licensing.

posts.name: outwait.lol
posts.tagline: Permanent product listing. Outwait everyone to own the page.
posts.description: Every "get your product seen" board works the same way: highest bid wins. #3 just means you spent more than #4. outwait.lol keeps the listing and deletes the auction. $0 buys a permanent spot - your name, your link, your category. It never expires, even if you fail nine seconds in. Position is the part money can't touch. Rank is how long you hold a button that appears at random. Miss once and the run ends. No revives, no bought seconds, no buying the top slot. Attention earned, not rented.

posts.name: WishPilot
posts.tagline: Free, local-first speech AI & interview copilot
posts.description: An open-source, local-first speech intelligence engine and live interview copilot. Features ~200ms Groq Whisper transcription, 9 unified LLM providers, Windows screen-share shielding, and adaptive frameworks (STAR, Big-O). 100% free with zero cloud logging.

posts.name: Powst
posts.tagline: Send B2B postcards in minutes
posts.description: Powst — Pick local UK business leads and mail postcards in 3 mins 🚀 Skip cold emails. Target 4M+ UK companies with automated direct mail.

posts.name: NidhiFlow
posts.tagline: Be your own CFO, or make your CFO decide faster & better.
posts.description: Every forecasting tool on the market stops at a number. Turning that number into a decision used to require a human analyst most SMBs couldn't afford. NidhiFlow closes that gap. Predict. Explain. Recommend. Execute. One product, at a price an SMB founder can pay. It acts as your CFO if you can't afford one, and it makes your CFO sharper if you already have one. Your runway at Nidhiflow's watch is Protected and growing, 24/7. We're live in beta, and we're the first to build this.

posts.name: NextHRMS
posts.tagline: All-in-one HR & Payroll Management for modern teams.
posts.description: NextHRMS is a comprehensive SaaS solution designed to simplify your HR operations. Automate payroll, track attendance, manage leaves, and empower your team with an intuitive self-service portal. Focus on your team's growth, while we handle the rest.

posts.name: rotation
posts.tagline: A globe of what every country is playing today
posts.description: Rotation Map is a globe of today's music charts: 166 countries, 174 cities, ranked by how much of their chart the rest of the world isn't playing, with the receipts under every record. Press a place and it plays. Pick a record and the globe inverts to show everywhere it's charting. Flip the lens by source: Apple Music, Spotify, Shazam. Shuffle picks a record, then a place, and says why. A seatback strip reads back miles, local time, weather. Night side lit by NASA city lights.

posts.name: OpenLivery
posts.tagline: Open-source multi-tenant WhatsApp AI agents for agencies
posts.description: Run WhatsApp AI agents for multiple agency clients from one self-hosted installation. OpenLivery is MIT licensed, with separate client workspaces, knowledge bases, conversations, branded portals and human handoff. Connect your own model providers and extend agents with HTTP tools or MCP servers. Full frontend, backend and Docker deployment included.

posts.name: CallPal
posts.tagline: Outbound calling for CRMs that never shipped a dialer
posts.description: The outbound calling layer for CRM teams. Click-to-call, power dialing, live monitoring and searchable recordings — with every call logged back to the CRM record it came from. It connects natively to the CRMs the big dialers skip: Attio, Close, Capsule, Copper, Insightly, Nimble, ActiveCampaign and Less Annoying CRM. And it's bring-your-own-carrier: connect your own SIP trunk, so we never resell or mark up a minute and your numbers stay yours. Outbound only — no IVR, no predictive dialing.

posts.name: SelfPDF
posts.tagline: The open-source PDF workspace for everyone
posts.description: SelfPDF is a free, open-source PDF workspace for creating, editing, converting, organizing, and understanding PDFs. It includes 30+ PDF tools plus AI-powered PDF Intelligence for summarizing, translating, and converting PDFs to Markdown. No signup required. Built with privacy in mind and open for anyone to use, inspect, and contribute to

posts.name: BuildMyMD — Modern Markdown Editor
posts.tagline: The Modern Markdown Workspace
posts.description: BuildMyMD is a professional, real-time Markdown editor with live preview, templates, badge builder, and instant export for developers.

posts.name: Qterm
posts.tagline: A terminal built for agentic development
posts.description: Qterm is a fast, lightweight terminal for AI-powered development. Run Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor Agent and more with projects, splits, persistent sessions and a keyboard-first workflow.

posts.name: Cadence
posts.tagline: The fastest captions, keeping you in the conversation.
posts.description: Live captioning for deaf and hard-of-hearing users. Recognition and speaker labels run entirely on your iPhone. Audio and captions never touch a network.

posts.name: Oars
posts.tagline: Your Linux servers, together in one local workspace
posts.description: Oars brings SSH terminals, files, logs, monitoring, deployments, backups, and remote desktops into one app for macOS and Linux. Organize your server fleet, run scripts, and use optional AI assistance with reviewed commands. Connection credentials stay in your OS credential store. Free and open source.

posts.name: Better Window Switcher
posts.tagline: Switch windows and browser tabs in 3D on your Mac
posts.description: A beautiful, fluid 3D window switcher for macOS on Apple Silicon. Every window and every browser tab as its own card, in true 3D with live previews. Fuzzy search across all of them, and one keystroke that switches back to your last window with no UI at all. Seven 3D arrangement styles. No account, one-time purchase, 7-day trial.

posts.name: SelfManager.ai version 5.20.1
posts.tagline: Date-centric AI Task Manager - Plan, Track, Review, Repeat
posts.description: Every day gets its own workspace. Organize tasks, add comments (voice-capable), take notes and attach images in dated tables, track your time, and keep long-running projects pinned. 1. Turn goals into editable daily plans with AI Plan. 2. Use AI Review to understand what moved forward, what slipped, and where your time went across a week, month or quarter. 3. Chat with your work and collaborate through shared tables. Plan, Track, Review, Improve, Repeat

posts.name: Ampel
posts.tagline: A traffic light for Claude Code in your Mac menu bar
posts.description: See when Claude Code needs you without switching terminals. Ampel puts a traffic light in your Mac menu bar: red when blocked on your input, yellow while working, green when idle. Track multiple sessions by project and optionally see your 5-hour and 7-day plan usage. Free, open source, and native to macOS 14+.

posts.name: Abrège
posts.tagline: Turn long WhatsApp voice notes into short summaries
posts.description: Most tools transcribe a voice note and hand you a wall of text that still takes 4 minutes to read. Abrège summarises it: forward a WhatsApp voice note to a contact and get the 2 or 3 key points plus the action to remember, in seconds. No app to install, no account to start. It works right inside WhatsApp, handles 100+ languages (tuned for spoken French), and is privacy-first: your audio is deleted right after the summary, servers in Europe. Free for 5 summaries a month.

posts.name: Selvra OS
posts.tagline: Stop trusting ROAS. See real profit. Fix it with a click.
posts.description: You check Google Ads: 4x ROAS, campaign's a winner. You check the bank: the money isn't there. Margin-blind budgets bleed cash, week after week, until it's inventory you couldn't restock or payroll you had to think twice about. Selvra OS tracks Profit on Ad Spend (POAS) instead of Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): using your Shopify costs, it shows what each campaign makes, then proposes the fix. A budget cut, a pause, a negative keyword. Approve it. No spreadsheets, no guesswork.

posts.name: TripPack: Travel & Packing
posts.tagline: Your itinerary + smart packing list, in one place
posts.description: Never forget an essential item or lose track of your travel plans again! TripPack is your all-in-one offline travel companion, smart packing list organizer, and day-by-day itinerary planner designed for vacations, road trips, business travel, and weekend getaways. Whether you're jetting off on an international holiday, going camping, or planning a quick business trip, TripPack helps you stay organized, stress-free, and fully prepared from departure to return.

posts.name: Pulse
posts.tagline: AI co-pilot for Product Managers
posts.description: AI-powered co-pilot for Product Managers and UXRs to make their day-to-day easy so they focus on decision making and not clearing out huge datasets. Making Ideation and Action easy! Pulse turns messy user interviews, app reviews, and feedback into decisions your team can act on : in minutes, not weeks.

posts.name: Kompresly Image
posts.tagline: Compress photos to exact KB/MB on-device — no upload
posts.description: I built Kompresly because job portals and email still demand photos under 200 KB or 500 KB, and most phone tools upload your file to compress it. Kompresly runs on-device: pick a target size (200KB / 500KB / 1MB or custom), batch photos, compare before save. JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC. If hitting the size would wreck the image, it keeps the best effort and tells you. No account. Free with ads.

posts.name: Alchemy
posts.tagline: Drop files, get suggested conversions
posts.description: Convert anything to anything: video, audio, images, and text. If the conversion you need isn't built in, just ask the agent to create it for you. Once you have an action you like, save it and reuse it whenever you need. All built in conversions are free. For agent powered actions, you can use your own API key, Apple Intelligence if available, or subscribe for unlimited agent calls.

posts.name: Weaveflow
posts.tagline: Your AI developer. Your server. Any browser.
posts.description: Weaveflow gives your app an AI developer. Claude Code runs on your server with your Claude subscription. Create a new app or connect an existing repository, then ask for changes from any browser. Open a live preview, publish when ready, and manage deployments, logs, environments, domains, and HTTPS from one dashboard. The work continues after you close your laptop.

posts.name: Automatically fix incidents (a harness)
posts.tagline: Autonomous LLM fixes incidents and creates PRs with fixes
posts.description: A durable, long-horizon agent harness that turns production incidents into locally tested, deployment-verified pull requests. Every intake protocol uses one filesystem-backed workflow, so tasks remain inspectable and recoverable while the process is running or after a restart.

posts.name: SAAS Founders Claude SEO Squad
posts.tagline: SEO, Growth Claude Squad for SAAS founders
posts.description: SAAS Founders Claude Skills is the squad of AI agents for founders running online business. Most of founders knew how to build and launch but main problem is SEO and growth strategy this Claude squad provides the team of agents that helps to does well with SEO and Growth. SAAS Founders skills does every job that a marketing teams does, Create SEO content find trending keywords, check AI visibility, generate SEO blogs, perform competitor research and more Save time with workflow!!

posts.name: Unveil SEO
posts.tagline: Internal linking that understands your content.
posts.description: Most internal linking tools rely on keyword matching. Unveil SEO uses LLMs to understand what your content actually means, then suggests truly relevant links, both inbound and outbound. Stop forcing exact-match anchors. Start building a content graph that makes sense to readers, search engines, and AI.

posts.name: ChatGPT Custom Premium Themes & UI Tools
posts.tagline: Customize ChatGPT with custom themes and powerful tools.
posts.description: 🔷 Akralys — powerful ChatGPT customization extension. Transform ChatGPT with animated & static themes, advanced dark mode, full UI editor (fonts, colors, layout), branding (custom name + logo) and high-quality PDF export of conversations. Works with GPT-4, GPT-4o and is GPT-5 ready. Ideal for developers, creatives, writers — fast, local-only settings with Manifest v3 compatibility. Features: 🎨 ChatGPT Themes: animated + static presets 🌑 ChatGPT Dark Mode & UI customization (fonts, colors, width)

posts.name: find-best-job
posts.tagline: Applies to remote jobs for you, with proof of each send
posts.description: Reads the job boards every day, keeps only the postings that clear your rules (pay floor, countries, language, ad age) and fills the employer's real form in a real browser: your answers, your résumé, submit. You get a photo of the page before and after every send. It never invents a fact: work authorization and salary come from an Answer Library you own. No LinkedIn Easy Apply, ever. Free: 1 application a day. Pro: up to 10 a day, when there is a posting worth it.

posts.name: Next Scene
posts.tagline: Make a movie together: the best scenes make the cut
posts.description: Start from a comedy opening, create the next 6-second scene in one sentence, and vote on competing scenes. The top-voted scenes make the cut; the rest stay as branches to explore. Download the movie as one MP4. Watch and vote free; $2 per scene. Launch offer: the first 20 accounts get their first scene free (the site shows how many are left). No app store, no ads.

posts.name: FCFStartups.com
posts.tagline: Bookkeeping for SaaS startups
posts.description: FCF Startups is a bookkeeping and tax firm for ventue-backed SaaS companies. We run accrual-basis books our investors and board can actually read, close evey month on a fixed schedule, and handle federal and tate filings, R&D credits, and Delaware franchise ta. No hourly billing and no generalist accountant leaning deferred revenue on your dime — just clean numbrs, accurate ARR and burn, and a team that already seaks SaaS.

posts.name: Tweezers
posts.tagline: Outbid-style social network where speech has a price
posts.description: Tweezers is an outbid-style social feed where starting a thread costs $1, but replying is completely free with an account. By charging for speech, bot spam and AI noise disappear: spend is the one signal nobody can fake. Top spots on The Board are held by the highest live boosts, decaying by half every 24 hours. Attach rich product cards to showcase your projects, build a profile, and join real discussions. No algorithms, no ads, no passwords. Just high-signal human thoughts.

posts.name: Lazy Ads
posts.tagline: Create, optimize, and scale your ads with AI or use the MCP
posts.description: Lazy Ads is an AI media buyer that creates, launches, and optimizes campaigns across nine ad networks from one dashboard. Connect your own accounts. Pay a flat fee, not a percent of spend. Networks: Meta (Facebook + Instagram), Google, TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit, Apple, Bing, ChatGPT, and Snapchat. Starter, Growth, and Scale include the Lazy Ads agent. Free is onboarding and competitor-ad browse (no AI tokens). Advanced users can bring their own agent over MCP.

posts.name: Linguiqo
posts.tagline: Localization without the usual limits
posts.description: Translation management for software teams. Sync with Git, collaborate with translators, use AI with your own API keys, and automatically catch outdated translations when source strings change. All features included, generous limits, from €9.90/month.

posts.name: Rimfold
posts.tagline: Tell us the park. We'll draw the trip.
posts.description: Rimfold turns a few trip details into a day-by-day national park plan, a cost range, and a poster-style map you can save or print. Most park trips start as 40 tabs of blogs. Pick a home city, a park, and how many days. You get overnight towns, a sane daily pace, drive times, and ballpark costs from curated park loops — not a chatbot. Stay with one park, or add a nearby park only when the drive is real. 28 parks, plus classic 7-day loops: Grand Canyon, Zion, Yellowstone, Yosemite, Smokies.

posts.name: PlusOnePlay
posts.tagline: Stop deciding. Start playing.
posts.description: Turn your Steam backlog into one answer for tonight. PlusOnePlay ranks games you already own around your taste, mood, and available time—then explains the pick and launches it in Steam.

posts.name: pomofox
posts.tagline: A cute Pomodoro timer that makes focusing more fun
posts.description: Pomofox is a cute, customizable Pomodoro timer with pixel-art characters, animated backgrounds, ambient sounds, custom alarms, tasks, stats, and more. Pick your setup, start your timer, and make focus time feel a little more like yours.

posts.name: Web Import Master
posts.tagline: Convert public or private web pages to Figma designs
posts.description: Capture any page you can open in your browser - public or behind a login - import it into Figma, and rebuild it as an organized design foundation with styles, variables, auto layout and high resolution images. Free Chrome extension. One-time payment.

posts.name: Slit — make your Mac unstoppable
posts.tagline: Clears your Mac before you notice.
posts.description: Slit is a macOS menu bar app that watches memory pressure, quits idle apps, cleans junk, and finds duplicate files. Free to monitor. One purchase to clean.
